video_title: PLENTY OF BEEF AND LAMB CHOMPS 🥩 Previewing Jayson Tatum vs. Jaylen Brown | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum last spoke in person in France last June
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum last actually spoke in person, face-to-face, in France in late June.

text_blocks.speaker: Malika Andrews
text_blocks.text: Given that back and forth that we just heard, when actually was the last time that these two players talked to each other?

text_blocks.speaker: Shams Charania
text_blocks.text: Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum last actually spoke in person, face-to-face, in France in late June. This was just right after the Giannis Antetokounmpo trade to the Miami Heat where the Celtics offered Jaylen Brown, but they missed out on it. And this was also just days before Jaylen Brown's eventual trade to the 76ers.

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum have not spoken since the trade
quotes.excerpt: Both of these guys who have been together for about a decade together, they have not spoken.
quotes.quote: Both of these guys who have been together for about a decade together, they have not spoken since that trade. Whatever had to be hashed out was hashed out before the trade occurred in person between these two sides. And at the crux of this is Jayson Tatum believing, Jaylen Brown believing, what Jayson Tatum knew or didn't know in the lead up to his trade.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum is being used as a solo act this season
quotes.excerpt: He's been the guy that they wanted him to be as the solo act.
quotes.quote: Even if they want to be friends and the conversations had or they weren't had, the fact of the matter is this was the game that I circled first on the NBA calendar. He has a career-high 33% in usage. He's been the guy that they wanted him to be as the solo act. So if he goes into Philly and does his thing with everyone trying to slow him down and have the other guys back, Jaylen Brown, I think it's going to be fascinating.

quotes.speaker: Marc J. Spears
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum called Jaylen Brown after the trade and was ignored
quotes.excerpt: I was told that he actually that day of the trade called Jaylen Brown.
quotes.quote: I was told that Jayson was in Vegas at the time he found out about the trade and he got some sage advice like, 'Yo, get ahead of this. Get in front of this. You're everybody's looking at you and your reaction now.' So I was told that he actually that day of the trade called Jaylen Brown to discuss what happened and, you know, offer him support and talk about their time together and then the phone call didn't get picked up and hasn't been returned.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics chose Jayson Tatum over Jaylen Brown for MVP consideration
quotes.excerpt: Here's a player with Jayson Tatum out last year was in consideration for MVP.
quotes.quote: Here's a player with Jayson Tatum out last year was in consideration for MVP, and at the end of the day they picked Jayson Tatum over Jaylen Brown. I mean, let's just face it as as it is right now. And then you have the team matchup, and no offense to the New York Knicks, the defending champions, you have the two best teams after 10 games squaring off against each other here on a Tuesday night.

quotes.speaker: Paul George
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul George says Jayson Tatum is locked in and playing at an MVP level
quotes.excerpt: Jayson Tatum is locked in, he's as professional as they come of preparing for a game.
quotes.quote: Jayson Tatum is locked in, he's as professional as they come of preparing for a game. He's been playing at an MVP level, and I think he's looking at it as, you know, another game on the schedule. Obviously there's a lot of noise surrounding it that hopefully he's not lost in, but it's our job to support him and help him through it and make sure his focus is where it needs to be for us to come out here and have a chance to play against a really good team.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: If fans boo, it shows they care about the players
quotes.excerpt: I heard from Scotty Pippen because I still was in my feelings after this happened.
quotes.quote: I heard from Scotty Pippen because I still was in my feelings after this happened. He said, 'If they boo, it shows they care.' And people are going to care about not only these two teams, but also these two players because of the drama surrounding it. And so I'm not like, you know, it's going to be interesting. Philly also, respectfully, is a very petty fan base. And so I think they're going to try to insert themselves to help their squad get this win.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics will send the cavalry at Jayson Tatum
quotes.excerpt: I believe that the Philadelphia 76ers consider that they they wanted to defend home court.
quotes.quote: I believe that the Philadelphia 76ers consider that they they wanted to defend home court. They're going to send the cavalry at him. This has been a great year for him as a playmaker. And so with them sending multiple bodies, he's just going to flex this muscle instead. I know he's number six in the NBA currently in scoring, but if he can create for others because they're going to send everyone towards him, this will be great for Boston.
